mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, description, goal, total_steps, current_step, status, progress_percentage, estimated_completion_hours, actual_completion_hours, start_date, target_completion_date, actual_completion_date, satisfaction_rating, feedback_text, created_at, updated_at, target_days, daily_minutes, focus_areas, progress
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_paths (user_id, name, description, goal, total_steps, current_step, status, progress_percentage, estimated_completion_hours, actual_completion_hours, start_date, target_completion_date, actual_completion_date, satisfaction_rating, feedback_text, created_at, updated_at, target_days, daily_minutes, focus_areas, progress) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{goal}, #{totalSteps}, #{currentStep}, #{status}, #{progressPercentage}, #{estimatedCompletionHours}, #{actualCompletionHours}, #{startDate}, #{targetCompletionDate}, #{actualCompletionDate}, #{satisfactionRating}, #{feedbackText}, NOW(), NOW(), #{targetDays}, #{dailyMinutes}, #{focusAreas}, #{progress})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learning_paths WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM learning_paths WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM learning_paths WHERE status = 'recommended' OR user_id = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
